items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: She joined us - we came into New York in '36, when Billie Holiday joined us in 1937.

ctx.x: Well, when did Miss Holiday join you, then?

She joined us - we came into New York in '36, when Billie Holiday joined us in 1937. She stayed with us nearly a year. Things were going and we finally got so that we could leave the Palace Theatre to go to the Apollo Loews State. Naturally when you leave the Loews State you can go from the Loews State to the other theatre and then finally when you was the epitome was when you could play the Paramount, because it was an outmoded thing that

you were going to play the Palace, because the Palace had always established itself in another vein and they did not go with the status quo so far as the Benny Goodmans and the Chick Webbs and the Jimmy Luncefords and what have you. They didn't go along with the jazz.
